overview.description: The Fidelity Enhanced Large Cap Growth ETF (FELG) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in large cap equity. The fund is actively managed, investing in large-cap growth stocks belonging to a broad US equity growth index. The fund aims for capital growth FELG was launched on Apr 19, 2007 and is issued by Fidelity.

data.text: BOSTON--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Fidelity announced the launch of six new active equity ETFs and reduced pricing on factor ETFs.
